subject.title: fix(agents): allow empty-error-retry when replayMetadata is absent (#97877)

question: Should maintainers use this PR as the canonical landing path for the linked empty-error-retry bug, or consolidate into another open candidate?
rationale: Multiple open external PRs target the same P1 runtime bug, and choosing the canonical branch is a maintainer coordination decision rather than a mechanical code repair.

options.title: Use this PR as canonical
options.body: Rebase this branch onto current main, rerun exact-head CI, and land it if checks stay green because it covers both per-attempt side effects and `server_error` routing with live-output proof.

options.title: Consolidate into another PR
options.body: Pause this PR and carry its useful tests or proof into the preferred sibling branch if maintainers prefer that implementation.

options.title: Replace with maintainer branch
options.body: Close or supersede the overlapping contributor PRs only after a maintainer-owned replacement lands the same retry-safety behavior.
